headline: SIGN AFTER CHANGES: 3 high and 1 medium exclusivity issues require redlining
nextAction: Karandeep will ask for changes to the exclusivity and liability terms to resolve the conflicts before signing.

findings.title: Collides with CloudSpan Technologies: Competing Platform exclusivity in India and GCC
findings.impact: Collides with the CloudSpan exclusivity commitment in India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar, live until 31 August 2028.

citations.quote: Quanta Lake appoints Partner as a non-exclusive Select-tier Implementation Partner for the Quanta Lake data platform in the Territory
Territory" means India, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and Qatar
Partner may refer opportunities, resell Quanta Lake subscriptions at partner-tier pricing, and deliver implementation services to Quanta Lake customers
during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC

Affiliate**" means, in relation to a Party, any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with that Party, where "control" means ownership of more than fifty per cent (50%) of the voting securities or the power to direct management

Territory**" means the Republic of India and the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council, being the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the State of Qatar, the State of Kuwait, the Kingdom of Bahrain and the Sultanate of Oman
Competing Platform**" means any cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform offered as a service

findings.counterPosition: Amend Clause 1.2 to exclude India, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar from the Territory during the term of the CloudSpan agreement.

findings.title: Collides with Zephyr Cloud Data Pte Ltd: Competing platform exclusivity in Territory
findings.impact: Collides with the Zephyr exclusivity restriction in India and Singapore, live until 29 December 2028.

citations.quote: Quanta Lake appoints Partner as a non-exclusive Select-tier Implementation Partner for the Quanta Lake data platform in the Territory
Territory" means India, Singapore, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and Qatar
Partner may refer opportunities, resell Quanta Lake subscriptions at partner-tier pricing, and deliver implementation services to Quanta Lake customers

During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter, Partner shall not, and shall procure that its Affiliates shall not, enter into or perform any reseller, referral, implementation, alliance or partnership agreement with the provider of any Competing Platform in respect of the Territory
Affiliate**" means any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party

Competing Platform**" means any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse or data platform product that competes with Zephyr Lakehouse, including without limitation those listed in Schedule 1, as Zephyr may update on thirty (30) days' notice
Territory**" means India, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam

findings.counterPosition: Amend Clause 1.2 to exclude India and Singapore from the Territory until 29 December 2028.

findings.title: Uncapped liability for non-compliance with platform focus commitment
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited monetary liability in the event of a non-compliance with the platform focus restriction.

citations.quote: Neither party is liable for indirect damages. Each party's liability is capped at USD 250,000, except for breach of confidentiality or Section 3.3

findings.standard: Each party's aggregate liability capped at 1× fees (paid or payable in the prior 12 months), mutual; carve-outs only for fraud, wilful misconduct and confidentiality (plus any carve-outs that are mandatory under the governing law, e.g. German law for intent/gross negligence and injury).
findings.counterPosition: Remove the carve-out for Section 3.3 so that liability for non-compliance with Section 3.3 is capped under the general liability cap.
